title: The Women's Final Just Out-Drew The Men's
hook: For the first time ever, more watched the women.
source: Nielsen/ESPN broadcast ratings for the NCAA basketball championship games, reported via Front Office Sports/Axios/NPR. 2024 figures as reported (women's final 18.9M vs. men's final 14.82M, the first time the women's final outdrew the men's); earlier years approximate as publicly reported.
